chapterTitle: Chapter 2 Polar Covalent Bonds; Acids and Bases
title: Problem 2-17

pages.text: PROBLEM 2-17 Using curved arrows, show how the species in part (a) can act as Lewis bases in their reactions with HCl, and show how the species in part (b) can act as Lewis acids in their reaction with OH–. (a) CH3CH2OH, HN(CH3)2, P(CH3)3 (b) H3C+, B(CH3)3, MgBr2
